Prompt: A clear review step before submitting important information.
Specify what can be reviewed, what can be changed and which action commits the request.
Who will do the work, review it and maintain the outcome?
What is the user trying to complete?
Describe the current flow and observed friction.
How do platform, industry, language and risk differ from the reference?
What would you reuse or adapt, and why?
Define loading, error, interruption, success and uncertain outcomes where relevant.
What can the implementation actually confirm or do?
What observable behavior would establish that this works?
Link evidence; keep assumptions and unanswered questions separate.
What is agreed, what remains open, who owns it and when will it be reviewed?
